text: Re-verified #6576, #6577 and #6578 on v1-development 78ee89d7f: the exact issue scenarios (predicate closes its cursor and reopens a different table under the SAME alias in the same work area) no longer reproduce for SCAN FOR, LOCATE FOR or GO TOP through SET FILTER, caught or uncaught: each raises the localized 'target work area not found' error with no replacement rows exposed and no out-of-memory fault (the cursor-generation fixes of #6331/#6242 cover them). Adding regression tests plus traceability evidence instead of a runtime change, then closing the three issues with that evidence.
